traces.caveat: Parent-state replay models current prewarming input; this is not an instrumented log of every prewarm worker. Other transactions may warm overlapping targets.

correctness.caveat: History-dependent targets verified by actual transaction traces and parent-state replays. Not a direct log of prewarming worker accesses or proof of a universal worst case. Physical I/O is measured separately. Quiet-tail persistence includes post-load transactions.

memory.scope: Whole node cgroup memory.stat, including all execution paths, prewarming, trie and persistence threads. pgmajfault is not a count of unique pages, and pgfault includes anonymous/minor faults. File refaults are separate counters, not a cache-miss percentage.

a.scope: Node cgroup, database device only; includes prewarming, trie/persistence, and other node work, not execution-only. Observer gas endpoints align with its I/O snapshots.
